snippet.title: Shleep - Count sheep to dream deeply!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://bippinbits.itch.io/shleep?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Count sheep to dream deeply!

It's time for bed... but how to fall into the deepest sleep? Let's count sheep!

Hmm, maybe this is going to be more difficult than originally thought...
